confounders: raw actor grouping and incomplete history coverage
denominator_rule: accepted change events; smallest actor count reaching at least 50 percent of accepted change events

params.scope: smallest actor count reaching at least 50 percent of accepted change events

status_note: published in rh-continuity-metrics/1 from exact actor-event counts

standards_crosswalks.upstream_definition: The minimum number of contributors responsible for 50 percent of contributions.
standards_crosswalks.local_population: Qualifying commit events in the retained generic-Git scan, grouped by the selected actor identity revision.
standards_crosswalks.local_formula: K50 = min(k) where the exact cumulative count of the top k actors is at least one half of all qualifying commit events.
differences: The local population is qualifying Git commit events; it does not combine releases, reviews, or other contribution types.
The selected repository and time scope are those of the local scan, and identity grouping follows the selected identity revision.
standards_crosswalks.interpretation_limit: Event concentration measures observed contribution distribution; it does not estimate how many departures would disable a project.
